name: 2 · Compliance documents: request → expiry alerts → verify

parameters.content:
## 2 · Compliance documents: request → expiry alerts → verify
Daily: missing document → upload request · expiring within 30 days → reminder · expired → "do not book" alert · uploaded → consultant verifies.
Each temp's compliance status is written back so the booking team can see it.

### Daily 08:00 (or from the console): document check
Never messages the same person about the same document twice in 24 hours.

### Temp opens the upload link
Photo or PDF, from their phone.

### Temp uploads a document
Stored under files/documents, marked "check needed", consultant asked to verify.

### Consultant marks a document verified (console button)
Back to the console afterwards.

### Consultant views an uploaded file
Opens the stored photo or PDF.

meta.description: Requests missing documents, warns 30 days before expiry, blocks expired documents and collects uploads for verification.
